scientific_integrity: Integer-exhaustive complete finite functional graph with two distinct implementations and directly checked all-state identities; no sampling, generalization beyond the tested finite graph, or independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem concerns only the ten-vertex Petersen graph for four states and thresholds one and two. It does not classify all Kneser or cubic graphs. Some older original texts could not be fully obtained; indexed-source search is not proof of historical priority.
title: Five-cycle survival and two four-cycle symmetry types in four-state Petersen excitation
